name: Savandurga
highlights: One of the largest monolith hills in Asia; a steep, exposed granite climb with a temple at the base.

name: Ramadevarabetta
highlights: Rocky hill in a vulture sanctuary near Ramanagara, with a Rama temple and the granite outcrops made famous by the film Sholay.

name: Kabbaladurga
highlights: Steep rocky climb near Kanakapura with fort remnants; a well-known night-trek destination.

name: Bilikal Rangaswamy Betta
highlights: Forested ridge near Kanakapura with a cave temple and a large white rock that gives the hill its name.

name: Hutridurga
highlights: One of the nine 'durga' hill forts around Magadi, with layered stone gateways and a Shiva temple on top.

name: Huliyurdurga
highlights: Steep monolithic hill near Kunigal with fort traces; a short but stiff scramble over bare rock.
